concept: One meeting room, one comment rebuilt in front of us. Nina's kind, empty line to Theo changes nothing; a label makes it worse; then the same speech bubble gains three coloured slots (what he did, what it caused, one step) while the wall screen and calendar show each fact. The viewer checks it on a Friday-night report, rebuilds their own comment on a sticky note at their own desk, and the room returns with the budget slide first.

story.metaphor: None: a literal workplace moment, rebuilt in place.
story.setting: A small meeting room after a weekly project update; the viewer's own desk.
story.arc: A kind, vague comment changes nothing; a label makes him defensive; the same comment rebuilt as behaviour, effect and one agreed step; the viewer checks and applies it; the next update opens with the decision.

devices.what: Nina's one speech bubble: the vague line (b01, ghost in b04 and b11), rewritten as the behaviour line (b07) with two dashed empty slots (b08), effect slot (b09), step slot with an agreed tick (b10), all three lit in turn (b11), small in the corner (b16). Each slot has a small colour tab: Behaviour teal (accent3), Effect sage (accent4), Next step ochre (accent2).
The same meeting room two-shot, Nina left, Theo right, same looks and sides.

Theo's slides on the wall screen with the clock, and the wall calendar: budget last and clock past the hour (b02), a replay of that order (b07), the budget decision card moved to next week (b09), budget first and clock before the hour (b16).
The three slot colours as tick rows on the answer cards (b12 to b14) and as the sticky note's empty slots (b15).
The one join material: a paper page turn into the check (b12) and at the time skip into the payoff (b16).

parts.what: The meeting room set: surface2 wall, a field2 table front one value step from the wall with its top edge across the frame at about y 900, drawn so people placed before it are hidden below the table top; optional table-edge nameplates Nina and Theo (first appearance). Room for Nina's bust at x about 360 and Theo's at x about 1560 (size about 560, eyes in one band), the wall screen upper left, the clock beside it, the calendar upper right, and the comment bubble's space in the wall centre. No people in the kit; no accent anywhere in the set.

A wall screen (ink bezel, surface face) showing Theo's slide stack as small slide cards with real titles: Design, Hiring, Vendors, Timeline, Budget question. States: blank, stacking (cards add one by one, Budget question last), replay (the same order replayed quickly, the Budget question card arriving last and marked), budget_first (Budget question card first, the others after), decided (a pos tick stamp Decided on the budget card). Accent only on the budget card when it is the thing named.
A round wall clock (Loom.obj clock style, ink outline). States: on_time (hands at ten to the hour), past_hour (hands sweep on to a quarter past), early (hands well before the hour).

A paper wall calendar with an accent3 header and two week columns This week and Next week. States: plain, flip (the page lifts and turns, with a small tab A week later), budget_card (a card Budget decision sits in This week), moved (it slides into Next week).

Nina's paper speech bubble, tail down toward Nina (screen left), Nunito body text in ink. States: vague (one line: Great job, maybe tighten it up a bit.), ghost (the vague bubble at low opacity), behaviour (row 1: tab Behaviour in accent3, text Tuesday: budget question on the last slide), slots (rows 2 and 3 as dashed empty slots that can pulse), effect (row 2 filled: tab Effect in accent4, text Budget decision moved to next week), step (row 3 filled: tab Next step in accent2, text Next time: decision first), agreed (a small pos tick lands on row 3), lit_1, lit_2, lit_3 (that row's outline or tab in the accent, the others paper; one at a time), small (the whole three-row bubble scaled to a corner). Rows 42 characters at most. It must fit with the wall screen and calendar still readable.
A stick-on paper tag with the words You ramble in Patrick Hand, accent edge. States: in_hand (beside Nina), stuck (flies and slaps onto Theo's chest), peeling (one corner lifts, it falls away).

Three paper answer cards in a row on a table top, letter A, B, C in Patrick Hand and the option text in Nunito body: A Be more organised. B The report came Friday night, so the team worked the weekend. Could we try a Thursday draft? C The report came Friday night, so the team worked the weekend. Please be more careful. Under each, a row of three small tick slots in the slot colours (accent3, accent4, accent2). States: in_a, in_b, in_c (each slides in), lifted_b (B forward), ticks_b (three ticks), ticks_c (two ticks), circle_c (the empty third slot circled in the accent), label_a (a small Label tag on A, no ticks), no_step_c (a small No step tag on C).

An everyday desk with no one at it: a monitor (ink body, surface2 screen), a mug, a plant, an empty office chair. States: chat (the monitor shows a chat message: Great job! Maybe tighten it up a bit.), sticky (a paper sticky note on the monitor bezel with the same comment), crossed (a hand-drawn line strikes it), slots (three empty coloured slots in accent3, accent4, accent2 appear beneath, labelled Behaviour, Effect, Next step), this_week (a small tab This week).

kit.notes: People are never in the kit: Nina and Theo are kit.peep busts placed by each scene with the literal story.cast look (Nina: woman, skin 2, cloth; Theo: man, skin 1, cloth2, flip true). The kit exports the three slot colours (behaviour accent3, effect accent4, step accent2) as constants. Clothes never use accent, accent2, pos or neg.
